scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation supplies universal proof. Finite checker tests are corroboration, not proof of all cases. Closest source supplies the fixed-pair folded-Gaussian gain and rank distance matching, not the full variance-optimal permutation classification. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional stagewise spatially integrated terminal-mean variance for equal-mass same-sign one-dimensional heat particles with independently reflected Gaussian matched pairs; only bijections are optimized. Convex-hull separation, not mere pairwise gap size, is required for unique reverse-rank optimality. Not a complete-path or arbitrary-coupling theorem. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent examination.
title: Sharp horizon-dependent rank reversal for antithetic Gaussian particle matching
